name: Vivian Lagrave
summary: Shadowmaster Vivian Lagrave asks you to speak with her in Kargath. Her business begins after a brief comparison with the Apothecarium.

sections.title: A Word in Kargath
sections.body: Vivian Lagrave, a Shadowmaster, receives you in Kargath. She remarks that the place has a stark charm, though it lacks the Apothecarium’s amenities. Then she turns from pleasantries to business and is ready to speak with you.

faq.answer: Vivian Lagrave is a Shadowmaster in Kargath.

faq.q: Where can I speak with Vivian Lagrave?
faq.answer: You can speak with Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.

faq.q: What does Vivian say about Kargath?
faq.answer: Vivian says Kargath has a stark charm, but fewer amenities than the Apothecarium.

faq.q: What does Vivian want to discuss?
faq.answer: Vivian says she is ready to turn to business, but gives no further details in this meeting.
